description: This PHP script generates an HTML sitemap for the SuiteCRM application's Home module. It builds an array of module links, fetches module-specific language strings, and outputs a nested list of links, utilizing the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: sm_build_array
methods.description: Builds or retrieves from session a nested array representing the sitemap links for available modules, including processing module menus to generate link lists.
